perf-bot: ALERT 2025-11-07 00:01 UTC — nightly/latency-dashboard: p95 +18% vs baseline for runtime-prod-nightly. Affected pools: nightly-1/nightly-2. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/p/latency/nightly

maria: Heads up — I'm seeing the same on traces. Pulling profiles now.

theo: quick glance: kernel_selector flipped a lot of requests to kernel_v2 around 23:55 UTC.

jana: Any recent merges to kernel selection or prefetch heuristics?

kevin: FYI PR #4821 (adaptive-kernel-scheduler) merged yesterday afternoon, landed commit abc1234. cc @maria

maria: grabbing kube logs + perf-top. Early signal: kv_cache miss_rate jumped.

maria: ```summary
kv_cache.miss_rate: 0.12 -> 0.27
cpu_user: 65% -> 88%
kernel_selector.threshold: 0.45 -> 0.60 (commit abc1234, PR #4821)
affected pods: runtime-nightly-1-{a..d}
trace_id: 7f9a3c1d
```

dave: note — CI showed a perf warning on that merge: buildkite job 742 flagged p95 +6ms but was approved after guardrail override.

jana: can we flip a runtime flag as a quick mitigation? rollback PR would be heavier.

kevin: I can flip the feature flag `runtime.use_adaptive_kernel` -> false on nightly pools. Doing a dry-run.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started update config `runtime.use_adaptive_kernel=false` on pool nightly-1 by kevin

perf-bot: metric update (00:08 UTC): p95 down 7% in 5m window after flag flip, but still ~10% above baseline.

maria: signal looks causal. I'll kick off a focused bisect across commits in PR #4821 and gather flamegraphs. Link to trace bundle: https://traces.redwood/7f9a3c1d

theo: profiling shows longer-lived allocations during kernel_v2 prefetch which increases KV eviction churn — flame: `kernel_v2::prefetch_loop` dominates.

kevin: if bisect confirms, plan is revert selector change and reintroduce smaller tuning. Agree? :+1:

jana: opening revert PR now (rollback-only).

dave: please tag on-call infra if rollout touches prod pools. This is nightly but could leak.

jana: revert PR filed -> #4890: "revert adaptive-kernel-scheduler (PR #4821)", assigned to jana. Rolling to nightly as emergency revert.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout PR #4890 -> pools [nightly-1, nightly-2] by jana

perf-bot: metric update (00:30 UTC): p95 back within 2% of baseline, kv_cache.miss_rate trending down. Marking incident as mitigated.

maria: good - immediate blocker cleared. Next actions: add regression test for kernel_selection entropy + kv_miss, bisect full PR commits for root cause, and write short postmortem.

theo: I'll prototype a CI workload to simulate cold-hot KV transitions and assert miss_rate < 0.15.

kevin: I'll follow up on the CI guardrail that allowed the merge after a perf warning.

dave: thanks team. leaving notes in incident tracker and assigning postmortem to maria+theo.

maria: adding timeline+links to the incident ticket now. Will loop in SRE for retro tomorrow.
